title: The Right Time to Judge a New CEO
summary: There’s a question several corporate boards should be asking themselves about now.  New CEOs will take control at Adobe and Best Buy in the coming weeks.  Stanislav Shekshnia, a professor at the French business school INSEAD, argues that the right time for all of these companies to assess whether they picked the best candidate is about six to 12 months into the CEOs’ tenures, which is several years before most boards do so, he says.
